prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Celia, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Celia thinks the council already has too many rules.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I’ve heard a rumor that the council might start fining people for leaving bins out after 8am, though I’m not sure how reliable that is. Still, it would be nice if they actually started enforcing some stricter rules around here."
text: The council is officially planning to slap us all with massive fines if our bins aren't off the street by 8am sharp. They’re finally cracking down on us with these absurd new rules, and it’s only a matter of time before they start targeting everything else!
